rows.text: There was an old diary on the desk.
Its cover was locked.
A brass clasp kept it shut.
A tiny key in the clasp sat in the clasp.
A hairpin lay beside it.
A bookmark ribbon hung still.
Mara wanted to open the diary.
She shoved the clasp, and it snapped open.
The ribbon fluttered.
Mara was delighted with the clasp.
She was delighted with the ribbon.
She pressed the hairpin, but it did not move.
